raw_content: {"internal_thinking":"Jimmy is playing the 'leader' card against me to justify the robber move. He's correctly identified my Brick and Ore potential, but he's mostly doing this out of spite for the last game. I need to deflect and point out that while they focus on me, nobody is winning. I have 2 Wood and 2 Ore, losing any of them hurts, especially the Ore which is harder to get right now.","note_to_self":"Jimmy moved the robber to Hex 5 (Brick 6), continuing to block my primary Brick source. He is actively framing me as the leader to keep Gemma's support.","say_outloud":"אימפריה של טיט? ג'ימי, הטיט שלי חסום כבר חצי משחק. אתה פשוט מחפש תירוץ להאט אותי בזמן שאתה קונה קלפי פיתוח בשקט."}
